statement.text:
Suppose that H is an almost simple group of Lie type and G is a finite group
such that G and H have the same sets of degrees of irreducible complex characters.
Must there exist an abelian normal subgroup A of G such that G/A is isomorphic
to H?
   Comment of 2025: The conjecture was confirmed for projective general linear and
unitary groups of dimension 3 (F. Shirjian, A. Iranmanesh, Illinois J. Math., 64, no. 1
(2020), 49–69).                                                         A. Iranmanesh
